title: World icon changer
description: press a key to change world icon
body:
Tired of seeing old world icon again and agai n and wanted to change in game 

this mod allows players to change world icon on key press defualt is F9 by pressing f9 players world icon will change to current screen

For better use it with Seamless loading screen:https://modrinth.com/mod/seamless-loading-screen
